mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_template (shop_id, name, type, amount, min_amount, total_count, start_time, end_time, status) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{minAmount}, #{totalCount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_template SET shop_id = #{shopId}, name = #{name}, type = #{type}, amount = #{amount}, min_amount = #{minAmount}, total_count = #{totalCount}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE coupon_template SET issued_count = issued_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND issued_count < total_count
UPDATE coupon_template SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupon_template WHERE status = 1 AND issued_count < total_count AND NOW() BETWEEN start_time AND end_time AND (shop_id = #{shopId} OR shop_id IS NULL) ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM coupon_template
name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
